title: Privacy Policy | Anwar — Finance Video Editor
description: Privacy information for Anwar's static finance video editor portfolio, including contact links, the WhatsApp enquiry form, hosting and fonts.
heading: Privacy policy
intro: This page explains what happens when you browse Anwar's portfolio or choose to contact him. The site is a static portfolio and does not provide account creation or server-side enquiry storage.

sections.heading: Information submitted through the homepage form
sections.paragraph: The homepage enquiry form uses the name, requested video format and project details you enter to prepare a WhatsApp message. Submitting the form navigates your browser to a WhatsApp link containing that prefilled text, where you can review and send it. The website does not submit the form to a site-owned database or retain its field values. The destination URL may be visible in browser history and is handled by WhatsApp under its privacy terms.

sections.heading: Email and WhatsApp links
sections.paragraph: Choosing an email or WhatsApp link opens the relevant service with Anwar's public contact details. Information you send is handled by that service and by Anwar as the recipient, subject to their applicable terms and your communications.

sections.heading: Hosting and external resources
sections.paragraph: The site is deployed on Vercel. The pages request the Inter font from Google Fonts where that resource is used. Hosting and font providers may process connection data such as an IP address to deliver their services; consult their current privacy notices for details.

sections.heading: Cookies, analytics and advertising
sections.paragraph: The site includes Google's AdSense script to verify site ownership for publisher account ca-pub-3376684105322240. The portfolio's own advertisement placements are disabled by default, and no separate ad unit is configured in the site code. Google may process connection or browser data when this external script is requested; see Google's current privacy information for details. The theme toggle changes the page appearance in the current browser session and does not save a preference.

sections.heading: Contact and updates
sections.paragraph: For a privacy question, contact Anwar at anwaransarijmt1098@gmail.com. This policy should be reviewed by the website owner for accuracy and local legal requirements before publication.
